technical_finding.strict_no_delete_sharing: blocks our own pathname replacement but does not reserve future pathname ownership
technical_finding.released_or_delete_shared_handle: permits an independent replacement between final validation and publication
technical_finding.in_place_write: not crash-atomic and can expose partial bytes
technical_finding.oplocks: coordination/cache mechanism, not a universal write exclusion barrier
technical_finding.txf: limited commit/rollback/process-death proof on one Windows NTFS host; not product-qualified and not adopted

decision: No defensible software-only automatic replacement method is proven under the required non-cooperative external-writer threat model. Do not enable APPLIED_VERIFIED for ordinary users.
preserved_guarantees: EXPORTED_VERIFIED never modifies the selected source
replay/idempotency and native verification remain enforced
no purchase, reward, coin, inventory or competitive state is consumed
remaining_gates: supported OS/filesystem-level transactional mechanism with cross-version qualification, or an explicitly accepted product threat model
clean-machine installer/signing validation after the automatic-write design is resolved
separate post-apply parse/reverification and applied receipt before any future entitlement consumption
next_concrete_experiment: Qualify a supported transactional/driver-level publication mechanism on every target Windows/NTFS configuration, with independent-writer, interruption and restart tests. If no supported mechanism is available, obtain explicit product approval for export-only application semantics; do not weaken the current safety gate.
